verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents a browsable model catalog at openrouter.ai/models, whose page is titled for comparing pricing and context. It also documents a GET /api/v1/models endpoint and an MCP server that pulls live model and price data, so the core of the story is first-party. However, the evidence never shows that the programmatic endpoint returns pricing or context-window fields (it only says it lists slugs), and context-window metadata appears only in a page title. Missing for 10: documented pricing and context-length fields in the /api/v1/models response, explicit context-window documentation beyond the catalog page title, and independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog metadata.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or query a catalog of available models with pricing and context-window metadata

citations.quote: Browse the full catalog at openrouter.ai/models, or list every available slug programmatically via the GET /api/v1/models endpoint.
